title: Mr. Opio Grows Food
subtitle: Working Fathers of Soroti
author: Anthony Mwesigwa
description: Follow Mr. Opio as he works his farm, grows food for his family, and sells crops at Soroti market.
keywords: farmer, farm, crops, Uganda, Soroti, family, work, father, village
dedication: For all the farmers who grow the food that feeds our families.
authorBio: Anthony Mwesigwa is a passionate storyteller from Kampala, Uganda, dedicated to creating engaging educational books for young African readers.
backCoverText: Where does our food come from? Join Mr. Opio on his farm as he plants, waters, and harvests. A story about patience and the rewards of hard work.
